inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: 10Y China government bond ~1.8% + beta ~1.1 x China/H-share equity risk premium ~6.5% = ~9.0% cost of equity; the company is net cash with RMB1.3bn of bank debt at 2.0-2.75%, so WACC = cost of equity. One rate across all three scenarios: policy-pricing, pipeline and 707 risk are charged in the scenario flows, weights and the rNPV haircut, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: lease_cost_pct_path 0.25% of revenue deducted inside the flows (FY2025 principal RMB17.9m + interest RMB2.3m = RMB20.2m = 0.24% of product revenue; interim CF line 2496). Lease liabilities (RMB66.6m) EXCLUDED from total_debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PPE 392.0 + intangibles 115.9 + long-term deferred ~10 = ~518 = 6.3%; H1 FY2026 254 = 6.9% annualised).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows left consolidated; non-controlling interests deducted ONCE in equity_bridge at book (RMB3,245.4m at 30 June 2026). NCI is the 19.29% of Sunshine Guojian (Yisaipu; 80.71% owned) and 12.84% of Mandi Inc. (87.16%). Book is a harsher charge than the historical NCI profit share (2-6% of group profit, FY2023-H1 FY2026), so it is the conservative choice.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, on the product business (biopharma sales + CDMO), with the Pfizer 707 contingent economics as a risk-adjusted equity_bridge item. Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 (operating company, non-US) plus owner-fcf-adaptations (currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset rule). First valuation of this ticker; no prior model to match. WHY NOT FY2025 AS BASE: FY2025 revenue/EBITDA/FCF carry the RMB9.4bn Pfizer upfront; the repeatable business is the RMB8.3bn product franchise, which fell 10.3% in FY2025 and a further 19.3% (biopharma sales) in H1 FY2026 under VBP, NRDL renegotiation and a VAT policy change. Product EBITDA margin (pre-SBC, ex other income) was ~32.7% in FY2024, ~25.6% in FY2025 (deal costs) and ~30.7% in H1 FY2026 after a 25% S&D cut; R&D is now ~18-19% of product revenue. H1 FY2026 OVERLAP: year 1 is FY2026 and the June 2026 balance sheet already contains H1 FY2026 cash flows; ex-milestone H1 product owner FCF was roughly RMB0.2bn (OCF 899 less the 852 milestone receipt plus ~128 tax on it and ~350 FY2025 upfront tax catch-up, less capex 280) and the overlap is immaterial. The year-1 modelled FCF (~RMB1.1bn) is above that depressed half-year run-rate and below FY2024's RMB2.06bn; it leans on the S&D cut holding. MANDI SPIN-OFF: a distribution in specie of Mandi Inc. shares to 3SBio holders is proposed (FY2025 AR 'Final Dividend' section); it transfers value to the same shareholders rather than removing it, so Mandi stays inside the consolidated flows and the 12.84% Mandi NCI is in the bridge. If the spin-off completes with a public offering, the Mandi shares received will need to be added back to a holder's position when comparing to this IV.

equity_bridge.item: Pfizer 707 (PD-1/VEGF BsAb) contingent milestones and royalties, risk-adjusted NPV
equity_bridge.note: Remaining consideration after the US$1.25bn upfront and ~US$60m option fee (FY2025) and the ~US$118m / RMB852m milestone received in H1 FY2026: up to ~US$4.7bn of development, regulatory and sales milestones, tiered double-digit royalties on ex-China net sales, and up to ~US$90m remaining China option/exercise fee (1530.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:438-456). Pfizer bears all development cost. Base rNPV at a 12% discount rate and 40% cumulative probability of first approval, USD/CNY 6.65 (= USDHKD peg midpoint 7.80 / CNYHKD 1.1726): development milestones ~US$300m x 75% / 1.12^2 = 179; regulatory milestones ~US$1.1bn x 40% / 1.12^5 = 250; sales milestones ~US$3.3bn x 40% x 50% of thresholds / 1.12^9 = 238; royalties on US$3.5bn peak ex-China sales x 12% blended = US$420m/yr x 40% x 10-year-equivalent annuity (5.65) / 1.12^5 = 538; China option/exercise ~US$90m x 50% / 1.12^3 = 32. Total ~US$1.24bn = ~RMB8.2bn = RMB3.17/share = HK$3.72/share (26% of the market cap at inputs.price_as_of). Unrisked PV is roughly RMB23bn; a Phase-3 failure or a class-wide OS miss takes it to ~0 (the true bear), a clean approval string to RMB15-20bn+ (the true bull). The bridge is scenario-invariant, so this single probability-weighted figure sits in all three scenarios; the scenario narratives state what each would imply. Sensitivity: each RMB1bn of 707 value = HK$0.45/share. This is the single largest judgment in the file and the most likely place for a reviewer to disagree.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year average of the product-revenue growth path (-10.3% FY2026 trough recovering to 2.5%); equity CAGR rejected as the anchor because FY2025 equity carries the RMB8.4bn after-tax licence profit and RMB3.1bn of placement/subscription proceeds
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: FY2025 is not a usable end-point for any series: reported revenue, EPS, equity and FCF CAGRs ending FY2025 are 25.9%, 59.7%, 20.5% and 65.9% (5-yr) and are licence-inflated. Revenue CAGRs above are on PRODUCT revenue (FY2025 8,269.9 vs FY2022 6,865.7 and FY2020 5,587.6). EPS, equity and FCF CAGRs are measured to FY2024, the last clean year (EPS 0.85 vs 0.62 FY2021 / 0.38 FY2019; equity 15,436 vs 12,227 / 9,625; owner FCF 2,058 vs 340 / 971). Product revenue has since turned down (-10.3% FY2025, -15.6% ex-licence in H1 FY2026), so none of the trailing CAGRs describe the forward path.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income), RMB m: FY2018 635, FY2019 971, FY2020 214, FY2021 340, FY2022 999, FY2023 1,230, FY2024 2,058, FY2025 ~294 ex-licence (8,694 as reported). SBC-adjusted and reported FCF CAGRs are close because SBC was negligible until the 2024/2025 award schemes (FY2025 2.7% of product revenue); the interest strip matters more (RMB150-210m/yr). Owner-FCF margin on product revenue averaged 14.1% over FY2018-FY2024 with capex at ~11% of revenue in the plant build-out years; the base path assumes ~14-17% on 6.5-7.5% capex.

base.growth_note: FY2026 = H1 actual product revenue RMB3,674m (biopharma 3,443.0 + CDMO 231.4) plus an H2 of ~3,745m (H2 FY2025 ex-licence was 3,915m) = ~7,420m, -10.3%. FY2027 flat as legacy erosion (TPIAO NRDL renegotiation, Yisaipu VBP, EPIAO) offsets the first full year of Yisaituo (IL-17A), NuPIAO (long-acting EPO) and 613 (IL-1beta); FY2028-FY2030 +4-5% as those plus 611 (IL-4R, NDA accepted) and SSS20 ramp; fade to 2.5%.
base.margin_note: Pre-SBC EBITDA ex other income, post-IFRS-16 (lease charged separately). FY2024 ~32.7%, FY2025 ~25.6% (incl. ~RMB280m deal costs), H1 FY2026 ~30.7% after S&D fell to ~33% of product revenue. Base starts at 27.5%, below H1 FY2026, because R&D stays at ~18% of product revenue (840 scientists, 25 candidates, 707 China Phase 3) while the S&D cut is only partly structural; recovers to 29.5% as new-product mix improves gross margin. Cash tax 18%: 15% HNTE rate on the operating subsidiaries plus 10% dividend withholding to the HK/Cayman parent and non-deductibles (FY2024 cash tax/PBT 18.6%, FY2023 23.9%, FY2022 15.1%). wc_capture -15%: receivables + inventory exceed payables by ~RMB1.9bn (~23% of product revenue), so growth consumes cash and decline releases it.
base.terminal_note: Gordon at 9%/2.5% is 15.8x FCF, so the 15x cap binds. 15x reflects a mature China biologics franchise under a permanent price-deflation regime (H-share pharma incumbents trade ~10-15x earnings).

bull.note: Legacy erosion stabilises in FY2027 as the VBP/NRDL resets are absorbed; Yisaituo, NuPIAO, 613 and 611 each reach RMB0.5-1bn by FY2030; TPIAO gains an ex-China registration (FDA bridging trial approved July 2026); CDMO keeps compounding; the FY2024 margin structure (~33%) is recovered with R&D partly funded by further out-licensing (not in the flows). Cap held at 15x: the bull is in the flows, not the exit multiple.

bear.note: The H1 FY2026 run-rate (biopharma sales -19%) persists into H2 and a further NRDL/VBP round hits TPIAO in FY2027; new launches only replace half the lost revenue; R&D is not cut, so margin compresses to ~22.5%. Terminal 12x for a no-growth, price-controlled franchise. Note this scenario still carries the RMB8.2bn 707 rNPV in the bridge; a bear in which 707 also fails would be ~HK$3.7/share lower than the bear value shown.

scenario_narratives.base: Three axes decide this name: (1) how fast the legacy biologics franchise (TPIAO ~60% value share of China thrombocytopenia, EPIAO/SEPO ~40% of rhEPO, Yisaipu) deflates under VBP and NRDL renegotiation; (2) whether the 2026 launch wave (Yisaituo IL-17A, NuPIAO, 613 IL-1beta, 611 IL-4R NDA) can refill it; (3) what the Pfizer 707 contingent economics are worth. Base: product revenue troughs at ~RMB7.4bn in FY2026 (-10%), flat FY2027, then 4-5% growth to FY2030 as new products ramp, fading to 2.5%; pre-SBC EBITDA margin recovers from 27.5% to 29.5% with R&D held at ~18% of product revenue; capex settles at 6.5%; 15x terminal cap. 707 enters at a 40%-PoS rNPV of RMB8.2bn (HK$3.7/share). Net cash plus deposits and WMPs of RMB17.8bn (HK$8.1/share, 56% of the market cap) is the floor under the value.
scenario_narratives.bull: The VBP/NRDL resets of FY2025-26 are a step-down, not a trend: legacy sales stabilise in FY2027, the four 2026 approvals each reach RMB0.5-1bn by FY2030, TPIAO wins an ex-China registration off the FDA-approved CLDT bridging trial, CDMO keeps growing 40%+, and the S&D cut proves structural so the FY2024 margin (~33-34%) is recovered. Revenue compounds ~5% over the decade. Not in the bull flows but implied by the strategy: a second out-licensing deal from the 25-candidate pipeline, and 707 approvals that would lift the bridge item toward RMB15-20bn (another HK$3-5/share). The bull does not require the 707 class to win on overall survival, only to be approved.
scenario_narratives.bear: VBP and NRDL price cuts keep running at the H1 FY2026 pace through FY2028 (product revenue -12%, -6%, -4%), TPIAO's next NRDL negotiation cuts price again, the new launches are themselves NRDL-priced and replace only half the lost revenue, and management keeps R&D at ~RMB1.4-1.5bn so the margin falls to ~22.5%; a no-growth franchise exits at 12x. The bear value shown still includes the RMB8.2bn 707 rNPV; a Phase-3 failure or a class-wide overall-survival miss for PD-1/VEGF bispecifics (ivonescimab's OS data were mixed) would remove it and take the bear ~HK$3.7/share lower. Even then the cash pile (HK$8.1/share before the NCI and dividend deductions) limits the downside.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: the repeatable franchise is shrinking at a double-digit rate under a regulator whose explicit aim is to cut the prices of exactly these drugs, and the H1 FY2026 interim shows the erosion accelerating, not fading. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right at once (legacy stabilisation, a four-product launch ramp, and the margin structure holding with R&D at 18% of revenue). Base 50%. The 707 optionality is handled inside the bridge rNPV, not the weights, so it is not double-counted here.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the business a buyer actually gets in October 2026: a shrinking but still very profitable China biologics franchise, RMB17.8bn of cash, deposits and bank WMPs, and a risk-adjusted claim on Pfizer's development of 707. The RMB9.4bn licence upfront of FY2025 is treated as a balance-sheet event (it is in the June cash), never as an earnings base; the product business is projected from its own FY2025 revenue and a component margin build anchored on FY2024 and H1 FY2026, discounted at a CNY cost of equity of 9%. SBC is expensed and the count held flat; interest and FV income on the cash pile are stripped because the pile is added back; leases are an operating cost; NCI is deducted once at book. The 707 economics are the hardest input and are shown as a single, separately-auditable bridge line with its PoS, discount rate and per-share sensitivity, so a reader who disagrees can substitute their own number.
key_risks_to_valuation: Legacy price erosion worse than the bear path: another national VBP round on rhEPO/TNF-alpha or an NRDL price cut on TPIAO (the single biggest product) in the FY2027 negotiation.

707 clinical risk: PF-08634404 is a later entrant behind ivonescimab (Akeso/Summit) and pumitamig (BioNTech/BMS); a class-wide OS failure or a Pfizer deprioritisation removes HK$3.7/share of bridge value.

Capital allocation of the RMB19bn pile: ~80% of the placement/subscription proceeds are earmarked for R&D and capacity; in-licensing or M&A at full prices would convert cash counted at par into assets worth less.

Mandi spin-off: a distribution in specie transfers value to the same holders, but a global offering at a low price or a loss of the consumer cash flows without an equivalent dividend would leave the remaining entity more dependent on the pipeline.
Currency: milestones and royalties are USD, the quote is HKD, the flows are RMB; a 5% move in CNY/HKD moves every per-share figure by 5%.
SBC is rising (2.7% of product revenue in FY2025 from 0.4% in FY2024) under the 2024/2025 award schemes and the Mandi and Sunshine Guojian subsidiary plans; the path assumes it fades to 1.5%.
